claims.text: Rosarkhiv describes the item as the typescript original bearing the autograph signature of Supreme Soviet Chairman B. N. Yeltsin (GARF F. 10026, Op. 1, D. 480, L. 75-79). The exhibition previews of leaf 75 (heading, a preamble citing the referendum of 17 March 1991, Articles 1-3) and leaf 79 (Articles 9-11, Yeltsin's signature and 'Москва, Дом Советов РСФСР, 24 апреля 1991 года, № 1098-I') agree with the portal text.
claims.locator: Exhibit caption; preview images of L. 75 and L. 79
claims.uncertainty: The previews are low-resolution exhibition thumbnails; the full-size images return HTTP 404 from every capture tried. Leaves 76-78 were not viewed.

scope_note: The 2012 exhibition page (caption and transcribed extracts of Articles 1, 5 and 10) and two preview images, read from Internet Archive captures because the official host refused connections. The transcribed extracts agree with the portal text of Law 1098-I.

visual_review.method: Low-resolution previews of leaves 75 and 79 viewed in the independent check and again for this packet; they are consistent with the portal text.
